conclusion: 128px retains visible tank/barrel, wall and >=3px object structure in these source-fidelity examples. Tiny projectiles and dense overlapping players are harder to separate; this supports a bounded diagnostic trial, not a reconstruction quality pass.
multi_barrel_resolution: Full original contexts confirm fixed multi-barrel shooting shapes (Triple Twin/Octo Tank), not independent automatic turrets.
